description: Lists the open issues in a repository that have no area (no [persona] title prefix and no persona: label), as the dashboard's Has an area line counts them, each with a suggested area, the persona: label that gives it, a confidence (high or medium) and a one-line reason. The suggestion comes from the repository's own issues: the area most of the other issues under the same initiative have, or else the area most issues with the same title prefix or scope have. When there is no clear majority, there is no suggestion, and the reason says why. Use it when your human asks you to tidy up issues with no area. Show them the list first, then apply only the labels they agree to, with your own GitHub access: the dashboard never writes labels. Read-only, and it never fails: if the list cannot be read it says why.

repo.description: owner/name. Optional when the token covers one repository.

suggested_only.description: Only the issues that have a suggestion (default false: every issue with no area).

name: area_suggestions
title: Issues with no area, and a suggested area for each
